title: Sleep Now, Predict Later
body: The Data $$100$$ team explores the relationship between hours of sleep, whether a student has a major affiliated with CDSS, and GPA. The team fits the following multiple regression model to the collected data: $$gpa_{hat}$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_0$$ + $$\theta_1$$ * $$hours_{sleep}$$ + $$\theta_2$$ * $$is_{cdss}$$. The fitted parameters are $$\theta_{hat,0}$$ $$=$$ $$1.2$$, $$\theta_{hat,1}$$ $$=$$ $$0.23$$, and $$\theta_{hat,2}$$ $$=$$ 0.5.\n##figure1.gif
